# Australia Wide First Aid — australiawidefirstaid.edu.au

> Australia Wide First Aid (RTO 31961) delivers nationally accredited first aid and CPR training across Australia. This site focuses on online courses and workplace compliance resources. In-person courses are also available at 105+ locations. Same-day certification, 10% Price Beat Guarantee, 4.8/5 on Google with 37,700+ five-star reviews.

**Book online courses:** https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/online-courses/
**Book in-person courses:** https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/courses/
**Phone:** +61 7 3437 7500 / +61 1300 336 613
**Email:** info@australiawidefirstaid.com.au
**Main site:** https://www.australiawidefirstaid.com.au

## Online Courses (Self-Paced, 100% Online)

All prices are from and may vary.

- [Asthma First Aid](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/online-courses/asthma-first-aid/) — from $19
- [Anaphylaxis First Aid](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/online-courses/anaphylaxis-first-aid/) — from $19
- [Mental Health Support](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/online-courses/mental-health-support/)
- [Pocket Mask Training](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/online-courses/pocket-mask-training/) — from $12, ~30 mins, renew every year
- [Safe Manual Handling](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/online-courses/safe-manual-handling/) — from $39, ~1 hr 45 mins, renew every year
- [Workplace Asthma Management & First Aid](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/online-courses/workplace-asthma-management-first-aid/)
- [Workplace Anaphylaxis Risk Management](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/online-courses/workplace-anaphylaxis-risk-management/)
- [Workplace Asthma & Anaphylaxis Management & First Aid](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/online-courses/workplace-asthma-and-anaphylaxis-management/)

## In-Person Courses (Nationally Accredited)

- [HLTAID009 — Provide CPR](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/courses/hltaid009/) — from $49, renew every year
- [HLTAID011 — Provide First Aid](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/courses/hltaid011/) — from $99, renew every 3 years
- [HLTAID012 — Childcare First Aid](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/courses/hltaid012/) — from $119, renew every 3 years
- [Workplace First Aid](https://australiawidefirstaid.edu.au/courses/workplace-first-aid/)
